Class CasseroleProperties.Pool

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.config.CasseroleProperties.Pool
Enclosing class:
CasseroleProperties
public static class CasseroleProperties.Pool extends Object
The Pool type holds the pool settings from casserole.pool. The window starts at 0, which means the yaml key is absent. The host starts empty, which keeps the local grok agent stdio child. A set host is the machine that runs grok agent serve. The port starts at 0. A port below 1 is read as the serve default 2419 when the host is set. The secret is the serve token. A blank secret sends no Authorization header. The secret is not written to the log by these methods.
